summary_md: **DwarfStar ([@DwarfStarDS4](https://x.com/DwarfStarDS4/status/2115411254760353960))** introduces **DwarfStar (ds4)**, antirez's small native inference engine for DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.x and Qwen3.8 on machines people own (Mac, DGX Spark, Strix Halo), with Metal, CUDA and ROCm backends.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - antirez/ds4: DeepSeek 4 Flash and PRO local inference engine for Metal, CUDA and ROCm

relevance: A lean, purpose-built engine for running max-tier open models on a single Spark or Mac.

media.description: DwarfStar (ds4) banner: 'Big models. Hardware you own.' Lists DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.x and Qwen3.8 with targets Metal (Apple Silicon, primary), CUDA (DGX Spark, multi-GPU incl. L40S) and ROCm (Strix Halo, Framework Desktop), plus make targets and memory needs.
